extraRules: Running the project's own migration script against the local dev database is yours to do: dry run first, then apply.

instructions: [tempo: dispatch] Delegation mode is ON for this session; the user asked for it with /work-mode out.
Batch work that a checker or a spot check can verify goes to a background sonnet subagent (the Agent tool).
Testable code fixes and adversarial review go to `codex exec --sandbox read-only`.
Judgement only the main model can make, or work that is nearly done, stays inline.
dispatch.nudgeTemplate: [dispatch-nudge] About {chars} characters of raw output read this turn and nothing delegated yet. Hand the rest of the batch to a subagent or codex if a spot check can verify it.

poolRouting.bothBlocked: Both pools are past the floor: keep batches in a sonnet subagent.
poolRouting.agyBlocked: agy is past the floor: send batch work to codex instead.
poolRouting.codexBlocked: codex is past the floor: send code review to a subagent instead.
poolRouting.bothOpen: Both are open: route as above.
poolRouting.prefer: Spend {pool} first this week: it resets in {reset} with {used} used.
poolRouting.claudeSoon: The main model's week resets in {reset} at {used}: inline reading is cheap now; batches still go out.

dispatch.gateTemplate: [dispatch-gate] out is on and {chars} characters are already read this turn: hand the rest to a subagent or codex ({hint}), or run `: # work-mode: inline <why>` to keep reading here.
